system.racialSkillNote: This race's skills depend on the form it wears: his changelingRaceSkillDetailValues holds a list for each of 41 forms. Choosing them belongs to the form swap, which is not built yet.

system.description: Fortune is rolled when this race is applied rather than being fixed: a d6 decides high or low, then 1d10 gives the size, for a result between -10 and +10. The Fortune modifier below is left at 0 until that roll is made. His sheet splits this race by physique, and only the slight-physique form has wings -- the ordinary form has no special movement at all. The port has no slight-physique option yet, so the figures below are the ordinary, wingless form. Awaiting the developer.
